name: job-inbox
description: Collects job-alert emails from Gmail (Indeed, Naukri) into one filterable list.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:mock: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "MOCK=true npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
